author: claude
summary: Desktop-scoped HIG fixes for the Chapter Editor / Director's Console (design-critique NOT APPROVED review): removed Booth mode's autoplay-on-entry (loads the render paused, autoplay controlled via a new playerBus/loadAndPlay `autoplay` option), removed the duplicate chapter-title heading in Revise/Write modes (ChapterWorkspaceHeader is now the single title location), consolidated the Bookmarks list-toggle to icon-only with a corner badge (was colliding/wrapping against its label at 1280px) and folded BookLayout's orphaned Lexicon toggle into ChapterWorkspaceHeader's single toolbar row via a new `rightSlot` prop, and replaced the DirectorsConsole rail's `btn-primary`/`btn-ghost` reuse for selected/unselected tabs with a dedicated `.directors-console__rail-tab`/`--active` treatment (left-border + tint) plus a `group: 'mode' | 'tool'` field on DirectorsTool and a rail divider between the two groups.

files.change: Added optional `autoplay` field to LoadAndPlayOptions (default true); loadAndPlay now sets `playing: opts.autoplay ?? true` instead of always true.
playChapter(audioUrl, title, autoplay = true) now forwards autoplay to loadAndPlay.

Mode-entry effect now calls playChapter(..., false) — loads ready-to-play, never auto-starts. Removed the now-meaningless autoplay-pulse mechanism (autoplayPulseRef, pulseSegmentId state, the pulse CSS class hookup) that existed solely to acknowledge the removed autoplay.

Removed the redundant `

{selectedChapter?.title}

` in the topbar (ChapterWorkspaceHeader already shows the title); removed the now-unused selectedChapter memo.
Added optional `showTitle` prop (default true) gating the panel's own `<h2>` title heading.
Passes showTitle={false} to ChapterTextPanel (ChapterWorkspaceHeader already shows the title in this context).

Added `rightSlot` prop for trailing toolbar actions (e.g. BookLayout's Lexicon toggle). Bookmarks list-toggle button changed from a text+icon label (collided/wrapped at 1280px) to icon-only (Library icon) with a small corner count badge; accessible name unchanged ('Show bookmarks').

Removed the standalone toolbar row that held only the Lexicon toggle (an orphaned button in its own dead vertical band); the toggle now renders via ChapterWorkspaceHeader's rightSlot, in the same row as the rest of the header.

Rail tabs now use `.directors-console__rail-tab`/`--active` (left-border + tint) instead of reusing `.btn-primary`/`.btn-ghost`; renders a `.directors-console__rail-divider` between consecutive tools whose `group` differs.
Added optional `group?: 'mode' | 'tool'` field to DirectorsTool (defaults to 'mode').
Added .chapter-workspace-header__nav-btn--active (was referenced but previously unstyled), --nav-btn-badge, --right-slot, and .chapter-workspace-header__panel-toggle rules.
